name: mermaid-diagrams-skill
description: The mermaid-diagrams skill's dependencies. They are here because the skill lives outside the projects (a plugin, or the cached clone of the bootstrap/mermaid.mjs launcher, which installs them itself the first time): without this copy the scripts would work only inside a project that already has mermaid, which is exactly what the skill should not require. The scripts still try the project you run them in FIRST: this is the safety net, not the rule.
